title: Uniaxial loading past yield with linear hardening
shows: Steel stretched to 0.4 % strain: elastic to its 250 MPa yield, then σ = σ_y + H·ε_p with ε_p = (ε − σ_y/E)·E/(E + H).
source: Return mapping for J2 plasticity with linear hardening: J. C. Simo and T. J. R. Hughes, Computational Inelasticity (1998), §2.2 (the one-dimensional case).
